name: Ottenbach (Germany)
description: Hanging banner divided vertically red and yellow, charged above the centre with the municipal arms of Ottenbach (a red stag over wavy water on yellow).
history: Municipal flag of Ottenbach; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Ottenbach arms — red stag on yellow
